valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027/28 underlying EPS viewed at the 12-month target date), converted from LSE ordinary-share pence to NYSE NGG ADR USD using the 1 ADR = 5 ordinary shares ratio and the 2026-11-13 GBP/USD close of 1.321.

bear.driver: Slower capex execution, higher gilt yields, or regulatory pushback compresses valuation multiple
bear.assumption: FY28E underlying EPS $6.25 (94.59p ord, +5% YoY) at 12.0x P/E

base.driver: Steady RIIO-T3 & US Northeast grid buildout inline with 8-10% 5-year EPS CAGR framework
base.assumption: FY28E underlying EPS $6.49 (98.20p ord, +9% YoY) at 13.8x P/E

bull.driver: Accelerated UK/US transmission investment and lower underlying tax rate drive top-end growth
bull.assumption: FY28E underlying EPS $6.61 (100.00p ord, +11% YoY) at 15.5x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY28E EPS of $6.49, the $84.29 close implies 13.0x forward P/E; the Street consensus average target (~$89-$91) implies 13.7x-14.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.49 (7.7 pp vs the $84.29 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Full-year FY26/27 underlying EPS growth (guided to 15%-16% from 78.0p) and capital investment delivery (~£13.5bn FY26/27).

analyst_notes: Named coverage in this sample includes 5 analysts (2 Buy, 2 Hold, 1 Sell) whose UK ordinary-share targets (1,110p-1,380p) convert to $73.32-$91.15 per NGG ADR at 5:1 and 1.321 GBP/USD. All five calls predate the November 5, 2026 half-year results where management upgraded FY26/27 underlying EPS growth guidance to 15%-16%, and exact broker note publication dates were approximated from 2026 tracking summaries with horizon_months set to null.
